name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CHAIRPERSON MANALO

  VICE CHAIR DIAZ | COMMISSIONER FONSECA

  COMMISSIONER BARCELOS | COMMISSIONER PALHINHA

  CITY OF ARTESIA
  REGULAR PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING

  TUESDAY, July 16, 2024 | 7:00 p.m.

  PRIMARY LOCATION

  City Council Chambers of Artesia City Hall
  18747 Clarkdale Avenue
  (562) 865-6262

  AGENDA ITEMS
1.  Call to Order

2.  Invocation

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

4.  Roll Call of Commission

5.  Approval of Agenda

6.  Announcement of Speaker Slips

  For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item
  on the agenda, please complete a Speaker Slip located in the lobby or at the
  podium and deposit it with the Community Development Director prior to the
  commencement of the meeting. Please note that there is a five-minute time limit
  per speaker imposed. Please stay within this time limit.

7.  Public Comments for Items Not on the Agenda

8.  Consent Calendar Item

  A.  APPROVAL OF GENERAL PLAN CONSISTENCY FINDINGS FOR
  PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT FOR ACQUISITION OF REAL
  PROPERTY FOR THE A.J. PADELFORD PARK EXPANSION PROJECT
  STAFF REPORT

9.  New Business – Non-Public Hearing (None)

  1
 10.  New Business – Public Hearing

  A.  Case No. 2024-14: A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT TO ALLOW THE OPERATION OF A RETAIL
  USE FOR A FLOWER SHOP LOCATED AT 18021 PIONEER
  BOULEVARD IN THE SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL (C-S-P) ZONE
  (CASE NO. 2024-14) AND DETERMINING THE PROJECT
  CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM CEQA PURSUANT TO CLASS 15301,
  CLASS 1 EXISTING FACILITIES
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  B.  Case No. 2024-17: (CONTINUANCE FROM JUNE 18,2024 PLANNING
  COMMISSION MEETING) A REQUEST FOR 1) A CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT TO ALLOW AN AUTOMATED DRIVE-THROUGH CARWASH
  WITH SELF-SERVICE VACUUM STATIONS 2) DESIGN REVIEW FOR A
  TWO STORY COMMERCIAL RETAIL BUILDING AND AN AUTOMATED
  DRIVE THROUGH CARWASH WITH ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING
  STATIONS 3) DESIGN REVIEW FOR A COMPREHENSIVE SIGN
  PROGRAM AND 4) LOT MERGER FOR THE SUBJECT PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 11701 SOUTH STREET WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL
  GENERAL (C-G) ZONE (CASE NO. 2024-17) AND DETERMINING THE
  PROJECT CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM CEQA PURSUANT TO
  CLASS 15332, CLASS 32 INFILL DEVELOPMENT
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

11.  Discussion/Report Items from Staff (None)

12.  Community Development Director Updates

13.  Items from the Commission

14.  Adjournment to the Regular Planning Commission Meeting to be held on
  Tuesday, August 20, 2024, at 7:00 p.m., in the City Council Chambers of
  Artesia City Hall at 18747 Clarkdale Avenue, Artesia.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please contact
the Planning Department at (562) 865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
